note: Dry-run evals: the skill takes real GitHub actions (labels/comments/PRs), so every prompt forbids side-effecting gh commands and asks only for the classification + reasoning (and, for the orchestrator case, the dispatch plan). We grade the DECISION, not executed actions.

evals.name: classify-clear-bug-as-doing
evals.prompt: You are running the triage-issue-worker skill on this single issue. Read the issue fixture at fixtures/issue-auto-fix.md. Decide whether it's fixable now (→ doing) or blocked on a human (→ pending, with kind decision/info/question), per the skill's decision table. DRY RUN: do NOT run any gh command, do NOT label, comment, branch, or open a PR — this is a test. Output only: (1) the label you chose (and kind if pending), (2) a one-sentence reason, (3) which file(s) you'd change and why. The fix itself is a one-line label-text change with a clear expected behavior.
evals.expected_output: Label = doing (fixable now). The issue is a concrete, in-scope copy/typo bug with a definite expected behavior and no open decision.

evals.name: classify-product-call-as-pending-decision
evals.prompt: You are running the triage-issue-worker skill on this single issue. Read the issue fixture at fixtures/issue-needs-decision.md. Decide whether it's fixable now (→ doing) or blocked on a human (→ pending, with kind decision/info/question). DRY RUN: do NOT run any gh command, do NOT label/comment/branch/PR. Output only: the label (and kind if pending), a one-sentence reason, and — if pending/decision — the concrete options you'd put in front of the owner.
evals.expected_output: Label = pending, kind = decision. The code is clear but the behavior (auto-cancel+refund vs hold-for-restock on out-of-stock) is a product/spec call the owner must make first. Should enumerate the options + tradeoff rather than picking one.

evals.name: classify-thin-report-as-pending-info
evals.prompt: You are running the triage-issue-worker skill on this single issue. Read the issue fixture at fixtures/issue-needs-info.md. Decide whether it's fixable now (→ doing) or blocked on a human (→ pending, with kind decision/info/question). DRY RUN: do NOT run any gh command, do NOT label/comment/branch/PR. Output only: the label (and kind if pending), a one-sentence reason, and — if pending/info — exactly what missing pieces you'd ask for.
evals.expected_output: Label = pending, kind = info. The report has no repro steps, no order number, no screen named, and no attached image — nothing concrete to act on. Should ask for the specific missing pieces (repro, order no, screen), not 'more detail' generically.

evals.name: orchestrator-resolves-all-triage-only
evals.prompt: A user runs: /triage-issue 백로그 라벨만 정리해줘 (no issue number, and they only want sorting, not fixing). You are the triage-issue ORCHESTRATOR. DRY RUN: do NOT actually spawn claude workers and do NOT run any gh command that writes (no issue edit/comment/pr). You MAY describe the plan. Explain: (1) since no number was given, what you do first; (2) how you decide between sort-only vs also-fix here; (3) the exact worker dispatch shape you'd use, including how you force the worker skill to run and which flag you'd thread through to each worker.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes no number => list open issues first and confirm. Reads '라벨만 정리' as the triage-only sweep intent. Dispatches one triage-issue-worker per issue (subagent, or headless claude -p whose prompt names the worker skill and is forced via --append-system-prompt) with --triage-only threaded through, excludes only skip- and approved-labeled issues. Does NOT read issue bodies or classify inline as the orchestrator.
